# Marina New York City

> Cinematic New York City stories, events, guides, photography, and creator work by Marina Kapler (@marina.newyorkcity).

Marina Kapler is a New York City content creator, photographer, and visual storyteller specializing in cinematic iPhone videography, brand storytelling, event coverage, and licensed NYC footage.

## Pages

- [Home](https://marinanewyorkcity.com/): Marina Kapler, NYC creator and iPhone videographer; event planner and highlights.
- [NYC Events](https://marinanewyorkcity.com/nyc-events.html): New York City events calendar with dates, filters, and practical details.
- [News and Press](https://marinanewyorkcity.com/news-and-press.html): Original NYC event coverage and press releases.
- [Gallery](https://marinanewyorkcity.com/gallery.html): Cinematic New York City photography.
- [Shop](https://marinanewyorkcity.com/shop.html): Lightroom presets, photography prints, and creator products.
- [Guides](https://marinanewyorkcity.com/guides.html): Interactive New York City travel guides.
- [Work With Me](https://marinanewyorkcity.com/work-with-me.html): Brand collaborations, licensing inquiries, and contact form.
- [Privacy Policy](https://marinanewyorkcity.com/privacy-policy.html): How visitor data is collected and used.
- [Terms and Conditions](https://marinanewyorkcity.com/terms-and-conditions.html): Terms of use for the website.
